title: 11 倒计时11
content_zh:
游决拿起精致的陶瓷勺子，往咖啡里一搅，层层叠叠的爱心立马变成一团形状诡异的泡沫。
在两人肩膀几乎都要靠在一起时，游决侧头忽然看过来，凉飕飕的眼神像一阵风刮过倪夏脸上。
倪夏垂下手，还没来得及动作，玄关处忽然响起电子锁机械的提示音“已开锁”。
她扶着墙将脚上的鞋子蹬掉，刚要穿拖鞋，抬头看到客餐厅孤男寡女——
谷雨声恍然大悟，重新打量游决，眼里全是满意，“原来是游律师啊，久仰久仰。”
接着意味深长地看了倪夏一眼，才穿上拖鞋朝着游决走去，“我是倪夏的朋友谷雨声，也是这个剧组的制片人。”
倪夏明白谷雨声那一眼是什么意思，但她不明白游决怎么也别有意味地看她一眼，才跟谷雨声打招呼。
“不打扰。”游决说，“正好我发现你和中悦财务对接的聊天记录不完整，需要邮件进行确认和补充，现在有时间吗？”
content_en:
You Jue picked up a delicate ceramic spoon and stirred it into the coffee. The layers of love immediately turned into a weird-shaped foam.
When their shoulders were almost touching, You Jue suddenly turned his head and looked over, his cold eyes blowing across Ni Xia's face like a gust of wind.
Ni Xia lowered her hand, but before she could make a move, the electronic lock mechanism suddenly sounded "unlocked" at the entrance.
She held on to the wall and kicked off her shoes. Just as she was about to put on her slippers, she looked up and saw a man and a woman alone in the living room——
Gu Yusheng suddenly realized and looked at You Jue again, his eyes full of satisfaction, "It turns out to be Lawyer You. I have admired you for a long time."
Then he gave Ni Xia a meaningful look, then put on his slippers and walked towards You Jue, "I am Ni Xia's friend Gu Yusheng, and I am also the producer of this crew."
Ni Xia understood what Gu Yusheng's look meant, but she didn't understand why You Jue couldn't look at her meaningfully before saying hello to Gu Yusheng.
"Don't bother." You Jue said, "I just happened to find that the chat record between you and Zhongyue Finance is incomplete. I need to confirm and supplement it by email. Do you have time now?"
